brief:
Palestinian families in threatened West Bank communities are mounting legal challenges to protect their lands from confiscation, according to the Palestine News Network. In Umm al-Khair, a village in the South Hebron Hills, residents including the Salem family face ongoing pressure over their property as they navigate court proceedings to retain ownership of their holdings.

The legal mobilization reflects a broader Palestinian strategy to contest land disputes through institutional channels while communities remain vulnerable to displacement from their ancestral territories.
dek: BETHLEHEM, West Bank On a rocky hilltop in Umm al-Khair, a small village nestled in the South Hebron Hills, the Salem family watches the surrounding landscape with a familiar, gnawing anxiety.
title: Palestinians mobilize legal battles against West Bank land seizure
